title: Delete the dead duplicate syncStatusStreamProvider/syncStatusProvider in features/sync/presentation/providers/sync_providers.dart and fix the false 'delegates here' comment in sync_status_providers.dart
rule: AG-4 duplicate top-level symbol names / dead code

evidence.quote:
UI can watch this directly; [syncStatusProvider] in sync_providers.dart
/// also delegates here.
// mirroring the core-layer canonical provider in

why: sync_status_providers.dart:17-19 and :34-36 both assert that sync_providers.dart's syncStatusProvider 'delegates here.' It doesn't: sync_providers.dart independently re-declares both syncStatusStreamProvider and syncStatusProvider with character-for-character identical bodies (same orchestrator watch, same late-subscriber loading-state workaround, same error mapping), under the same names. Grepping every consumer of these two symbol names across lib/ shows dashboard_screen.dart, backup_sync_section.dart and sync_status_indicator.dart all import exclusively from core/sync/providers/sync_status_providers.dart; nothing anywhere imports or references the copy in sync_providers.dart. It is fully dead code with a misleading doc comment, and it demonstrates the exact shotgun-surgery risk duplication creates: the 'late subscriber to a broadcast stream' loading-state fix (the loop-iter2/orchestrator.currentStatus fallback) had to be applied to both copies in parallel, and nothing prevents the next fix from being applied to only one.
recommendation: Delete syncStatusStreamProvider/syncStatusProvider from features/sync/presentation/providers/sync_providers.dart (confirmed zero production consumers); any future consumer should import core/sync/providers/sync_status_providers.dart directly. Correct or remove the 'also delegates here' comment once the duplicate is gone.
acceptance_criteria: features/sync/presentation/providers/sync_providers.dart no longer defines syncStatusStreamProvider or syncStatusProvider.
grep -rn 'final syncStatusStreamProvider\|final syncStatusProvider' lib/ returns exactly one definition site each.
flutter analyze and the existing sync-status widget tests (sync_status_indicator_l1_test.dart, backup_sync_section_l1_test.dart, sync_status_provider_loading_state_test.dart) still pass unchanged.
mergedFrom: syncStatusProvider/syncStatusStreamProvider are duplicated verbatim between core/sync and features/sync -- the unread copy still needed its own bugfix
